p001.title: VEILOS
p001.description: An operating system designed as an alternative to Windows 11, with decisive architectural differences that allow for better hardware control, better security, and better performance.

p002.title: VEIL-GUARD mkI
p002.description: the first version of veilguard designed and written in python using standard pthon encryption libraries. the app has a basic stack of these aftformentioned standards to encrypt files and store the keys in vault folders mixed with chaff.

p003.title: VEIL-GUARD mkII
p003.description: an encryption app designed for secure file encryption and key vaults rewritten in Rust, this version of the app is more secure than the previous version by utilising a rotating encryption stack based on numerous seperate factors.

p004.title: VEIL-GUARD mkIII
p004.description: an encryption app with a pleathora of features such as key vaults, encrypted p2p chat, file/text encoding and file encryption all using custom stacks of encryption standards including PQM.
